title: Definition of the Fare That Bands a Checked-Bag Charge
content:
**Revenue accounting definition — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The fare that bands the bag charge is measured by one of three conventions:

| Ticket | Fare that bands the bag charge |
|---|---|
| At least one flown coupon | The fare still unflown: the fare collected less the coupon value already flown |
| No flown coupon, and names an active corporate agreement | The ticket's base fare, before taxes and fees |
| Any other ticket | The fare collected: every fare-collection and add-collect entry |

The first row applies whenever a coupon has been flown, whether or not the ticket names an agreement. The coupon value already flown is every flown-coupon entry on the ticket; the base fare is the one recorded on the ticket.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Ticket | Fare collected | Base fare | Coupon value flown | Fare that bands the charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| One coupon flown, active agreement | 560.00 | 470.00 | 250.00 | 310.00 |
| Nothing flown, active agreement | 560.00 | 470.00 | 0 | 470.00 |
| Nothing flown, no agreement | 560.00 | 470.00 | 0 | 560.00 |
